summary: Import thunk (stdcall) that forwards inet_addr(cp) to the imported Winsock implementation __imp_inet_addr. Parses a dotted-quad IPv4 address string cp into its in-network-order unsigned 32-bit representation. No local logic; the entire behavior is the forwarded import.

operations.description: Forward the call to the imported Winsock function __imp_inet_addr(cp), which performs the actual dotted-quad string to binary address conversion.
Return the unsigned int result produced by the forwarded import call.
Used by sub_562010, sub_562D90, NetworkConnection (0x00563260), sub_563AB0 and NetworkAddressParser (0x005642B0) to convert IPv4 address strings during connection setup and address parsing.

unresolved: The exact semantics of the conversion live inside the imported Winsock function, not in this thunk.
